Heard Sri Akash Kishan, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Shri Vivek Shukla, learned
Aga appearing for the State respondent.

2. The present petition has been filed with a prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report
dated 29.06.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 122 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 272,
273 Ipc, Section 59 of Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, Sections 63, 65, 68 of Copyright Act, 1957
and Sections 103, 104 of Trademark Act, P.S. Kotwali Rajapur, District Chitrakoot and for a

3.
Shri Akash Kishan, learned counsel for the petitioner prays that he may be permitted to withdraw the present petition.
4. Present petition is, accordingly, dismissed as withdrawn.
5. It is made clear that no liberty is granted to the petitioner to file a fresh petition for the same cause of action.
